mapper.select: SELECT isp.id, isp.scheme_id, isp.version_id, isp.package_id, isp.inspect_item_id, isp.item_config_id, isp.parameter_id, isp.record_id AS recordId, isp.record_version_id AS recordVersionId, isp.record_item_id AS recordItemId, im.code AS recordCode, im.name AS recordName, isp.standard_rule, isp.is_reportable, isp.is_executable, isp.final_expression, isp.execute_method, ip.name AS parameter_name, ip.code AS parameter_code FROM lm_inspection_scheme_parameter isp LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_parameter ip ON isp.parameter_id = ip.id LEFT JOIN bm_batch_record im ON isp.record_id = im.id AND im.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN bm_batch_record_version rv ON isp.record_version_id = rv.id AND rv.is_deleted = 0 WHERE isp.item_config_id = #{itemConfigId} AND isp.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY isp.id ASC

SELECT isp.id, isp.scheme_id, isp.version_id, isp.package_id, isp.inspect_item_id, isp.item_config_id, isp.parameter_id, isp.record_id AS recordId, isp.record_version_id AS recordVersionId, isp.record_item_id AS recordItemId, im.code AS recordCode, im.name AS recordName, rv.version AS recordVersion, isp.standard_rule, isp.is_reportable, isp.is_executable, isp.final_expression, isp.execute_method, ip.name AS parameter_name, ip.code AS parameter_code FROM lm_inspection_scheme_parameter isp LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_parameter ip ON isp.parameter_id = ip.id LEFT JOIN bm_batch_record im ON isp.record_id = im.id AND im.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN bm_batch_record_version rv ON isp.record_version_id = rv.id AND rv.is_deleted = 0 WHERE isp.id = #{parameterConfigId} AND isp.is_deleted = 0

select distinct t1.parameter_id as parameterId, t1.record_item_id as recordItemId, t1.id as parameterConfigId, t1.record_version_id, t2.component_type, t2.field_id from lm_inspection_scheme_parameter t1 join bm_batch_record_component t2 on t1.record_id = t2.record_id and t1.record_version_id = t2.record_version_id and t2.is_deleted = 0 where t1.is_deleted = 0 and t1.scheme_id = #{query.schemeId} and t1.version_id = #{query.schemeVersionId} and t2.field_id in
